text: The question and answer with regard to the need for the text of the angel are quoted here in the same words in which they are quoted in the discussion on the Mishnah. This can either mean that both sugyas are quoting a well-known question and answer quoted in the Mishnah. The queshor and auswer quoted for the fext of fle augel are geoteo here in the same words which He ore quoted in He discuseiou on He Hishuah. This can either mean that both sugyas are quoting the same well-known texts quoted in He Hishuah.
